Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: When work piles up like this, taking even a short break actually helps you work better.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 요즘처럼 일이 몰릴 때는 잠깐이라도 쉬어 주는 게 오히려 능률에 좋더라고요.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: You agreed to gather yesterday's meeting comments into a report and submit it by tomorrow.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Even after a long time apart, it felt natural and easy to talk just like before.

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: You were worried at first, but once you actually tried it, it turned out much easier.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: To pronounce Korean accurately, you have to read out loud every day.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 한국어 발음을 정확하게 하려면 매일 소리 내어 읽어야 해요.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: I went to the restaurant my friend recommended, and the food was really good.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 친구가 추천해 준 식당에 갔는데 정말 맛있었어요.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: It has been chilly lately, so I always take a jacket when I go out.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 요즘은 날씨가 쌀쌀해서 외출할 때 겉옷을 꼭 챙겨요.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: To do well on this exam, you need to make a plan and study steadily.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 이번 시험을 잘 보려면 계획을 세워서 꾸준히 공부해야 해요.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: It was hard at first, but I keep practising and I am slowly getting better.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 처음에는 어려웠지만 계속 연습하니까 조금씩 나아지고 있어요.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: I keep forgetting to call my parents, so I always feel a bit guilty.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 부모님께 전화드리는 걸 자꾸 잊어버려서 늘 죄송한 마음이에요.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: The meeting ran longer than expected, so I ended up eating lunch late.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 회의가 예상보다 길어져서 점심을 늦게 먹게 되었어요.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: I like the new phone that came out, but the price is too high.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 새로 나온 휴대폰이 마음에 들지만 가격이 너무 비싸요.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: Before you travel, book your accommodation and transport in advance.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 여행을 가기 전에 숙소와 교통편을 미리 예약해 두세요.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: I tend to get a bit nervous when I speak in front of people.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 저는 사람들 앞에서 이야기할 때 조금 긴장하는 편이에요.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: My child has caught a cold, so I think I need to take them to the doctor today.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 아이가 감기에 걸려서 오늘은 병원에 다녀와야 할 것 같아요.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: If I drink too much coffee, I have trouble falling asleep at night.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 커피를 너무 많이 마시면 밤에 잠이 잘 안 와요.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: There is a quiet cafe with a nice atmosphere near here.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 이 근처에 조용하고 분위기 좋은 카페가 하나 있어요.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: I went back to my hometown after a long time and had a lovely time with my family.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 오랜만에 고향에 내려가서 가족들과 즐거운 시간을 보냈어요.

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: Since I started exercising, both my body and my mind feel much lighter.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 운동을 시작한 뒤로 몸도 마음도 훨씬 가벼워진 느낌이에요.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: If you had known in advance, you would have prepared much more carefully.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 제가 미리 알았더라면 훨씬 더 신중하게 준비했을 텐데요.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: It would be better to discuss that matter directly with the person in charge.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 그 문제에 대해서는 담당자와 직접 상의하시는 편이 낫겠습니다.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Because the meeting ran long you had to push back all your later plans.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 회의가 길어지는 바람에 다음 일정을 모두 미뤄야 했어요.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: It felt unfamiliar at first, but over time it has become truly comfortable.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 처음에는 낯설었지만 지내다 보니 이제는 정말 편해졌어요.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Given the conditions you mentioned, your side can certainly consider it.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 말씀하신 조건이라면 저희도 충분히 검토해 볼 수 있습니다.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: You did not need to go to so much trouble, and you are truly grateful.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 그렇게까지 애쓰지 않으셔도 되는데 정말 감사드립니다.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Because prices keep rising these days the burden of living costs has grown.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 요즘 물가가 계속 오르는 탓에 생활비 부담이 커졌어요.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: It is a bit disappointing from your position, but you will respect the decision.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 제 입장에서는 조금 아쉽지만 결정을 존중하도록 하겠습니다.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: If any problem should arise, the person is welcome to contact you anytime.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 혹시라도 문제가 생기면 언제든지 편하게 연락 주시기 바랍니다.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: That person has an outstanding ability to calmly sort out any situation.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 그 사람은 늘 침착하게 상황을 정리하는 능력이 뛰어납니다.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: After considering many things you finally came to this decision.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 여러 가지를 고려한 끝에 결국 이렇게 결정하게 되었습니다.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Now that you have heard it, it seems you had completely misunderstood the situation.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 듣고 보니 제가 상황을 완전히 오해하고 있었던 것 같네요.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: The harder the pronunciation, the more important it is to practice slowly and repeatedly.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 발음이 어려울수록 천천히 반복해서 연습하는 것이 중요합니다.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Contrary to expectations there were many attendees, so more seats had to be arranged.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 예상과 달리 참석자가 많아서 자리를 더 마련해야 했습니다.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: In the current situation it would be wiser to wait a little rather than rush.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 지금 상황에서는 서두르기보다 조금 기다리는 편이 현명하겠습니다.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Thanks to the experience built up over time you were able to get through a hard patch.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 그동안 쌓아 온 경험 덕분에 어려운 고비를 넘길 수 있었어요.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Above all, an attitude of trying to understand each other is what is most needed.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 무엇보다 서로의 입장을 이해하려는 태도가 가장 필요합니다.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: If you practice consistently your skills naturally improve over time.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 연습을 꾸준히 하다 보면 자연스럽게 실력이 늘기 마련입니다.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: If it is all right, you will organize the details in writing and send them over.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 괜찮으시다면 자세한 내용은 서면으로 정리해서 보내 드리겠습니다.

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Only after time passes will it be possible to know whether that decision was right.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 그 결정이 옳았는지는 시간이 지나야 비로소 알 수 있을 겁니다.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: A simple greeting followed by saying that you are a student.
You are remarking that the weather is lovely today and inviting agreement.
You drink coffee every morning as part of your routine.
You are asking someone to tell you what this dish is called.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: 이 음식 이름이 뭐예요 알려 주세요.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: Your friend is at home right now.
A polite way to ask for a glass of water and say thank you.
You are letting someone know you are learning a little Korean.
You are asking someone where the restroom is.
You feel tired today, so you plan to go to bed early.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: 오늘은 좀 피곤해서 일찍 잘 거예요.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: You are suggesting that the two of you go out for lunch together.
This tastes really good and you are urging someone to try it.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: 이거 정말 맛있어요 한번 드셔 보세요.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: You are offering to repeat your name one more time.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: 제 이름을 다시 한번 말해 줄게요.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: You take the subway to get to work.
You are asking someone to wait a moment because you will be there soon.
You are curious about what the other person usually does on weekends.
A polite request for the other person to speak more slowly.
You really enjoy spicy food.
You are saying it was nice to meet today and you hope to meet again.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: 오늘 만나서 정말 반가웠어요 또 봐요.

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: There is a nice cafe somewhere nearby.
You take a walk in the park every evening.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: Work has been so busy lately that you have no time to exercise.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 요즘 일이 너무 바빠서 운동할 시간이 없어요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: You contacted the person in advance because you think you will be late.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 약속 시간에 늦을 것 같아서 미리 연락드렸어요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: The movie turned out to be far more moving than you expected.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 그 영화는 생각보다 훨씬 감동적이었어요 정말로.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: The moment you wake up in the morning you drink a glass of water.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 저는 아침에 일어나자마자 물을 한 잔 마셔요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: A polite way to ask whether you may sit in this seat.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 혹시 이 자리에 앉아도 괜찮을지 여쭤봐도 될까요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: It suddenly got cold, so you took out your heavy clothes.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 날씨가 갑자기 추워져서 두꺼운 옷을 꺼냈어요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: You are in a meeting now and will call the person back later.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 제가 지금 회의 중이라 나중에 다시 전화드릴게요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: While learning Korean you have made many new friends.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 한국어를 배우면서 새로운 친구들을 많이 사귀었어요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: You are asking whether the person knows a place to park nearby.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 이 근처에 주차할 만한 곳이 있는지 아세요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: You worked until late last night, so you feel tired today.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 어제 밤늦게까지 일해서 오늘은 좀 피곤하네요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: The food you ordered has not arrived yet, so you are waiting a bit.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 주문한 음식이 아직 안 나와서 조금 기다리고 있어요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: In your opinion that plan seems a little risky.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 제 생각에는 그 계획이 조금 위험한 것 같아요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: If possible you would like to move the schedule to next Tuesday.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 가능하면 다음 주 화요일로 일정을 옮기고 싶어요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: You cannot handle spicy food well, so you ask for only a little.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 저는 매운 걸 잘 못 먹으니까 조금만 넣어 주세요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: It is better to book tickets in advance before traveling.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 여행을 가기 전에 미리 표를 예매하는 게 좋아요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: After hearing that, you felt much more at ease.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 그 말을 듣고 나서 마음이 훨씬 편해졌어요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: These days you practice listening by watching Korean dramas.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 요즘 한국 드라마를 보면서 듣기 연습을 하고 있어요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: If the person has time, you would like to chat for a moment.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 혹시 시간 괜찮으시면 잠깐 이야기 좀 나눌까요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: Traffic was worse than expected so you were about half an hour late.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 생각보다 길이 많이 막혀서 삼십 분 정도 늦었어요.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: This weekend you plan to rest well at home and read books.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 이번 주말에는 집에서 푹 쉬면서 책을 읽을 거예요.
